name: Community Schools @Murrell Dobbins CTE High School

lead_descriptions.text: Who We Are: Murrell Dobbins CTE High School is a Community School, serving 500+ students in grades 9-12. It collaborates with the City of Philadelphia, the School District, community-based organizations, and the residents of Philadelphia to pave the way for student success. | What We Do: Our students are supported by two Community School Coordinators. Volunteers are needed to distribute groceries (weekly) to students and families, run the food and clothing pantries, support special events like resource fairs, and more. Scroll down to Program Opportunities to get involved today!
